entities.name: Provided RibBA
observations: 554 aa protein; predicted molecular weight 61.86 kDa and theoretical pI 5.56.
Pfam detects DHBP_synthase at residues 11–204 and GTP_cyclohydro2 at residues 217–381.
Strong homology to reviewed RibBA P74104: 72.3% identity, 95.1% query coverage, E-value 8.17e-276.
Likely bifunctional riboflavin-biosynthesis enzyme; exact substrate specificity is inferred from homologs and domains.
Likely cytosolic and metal-dependent, based on RibBA homolog annotations; direct localization and oligomerization were not established for this sequence.

entities.name: RibBA P74104
observations: Reviewed Synechocystis sp. RibBA homolog with 72.3% identity and 95.1% query coverage to the provided sequence.
Catalyzes DHBP synthase and GTP cyclohydrolase II reactions in riboflavin biosynthesis.
Annotated to bind Mg2+/Mn2+ and Zn2+; annotated as cytosolic.

entities.name: Riboflavin biosynthesis
observations: RibBA supplies two early branch-specific intermediates: 3,4-dihydroxy-2-butanone 4-phosphate from D-ribulose 5-phosphate and a pyrimidine precursor from GTP.
The pathway produces precursors required for vitamin B2 (riboflavin) formation.

entities.name: DHBP synthase reaction
observations: D-ribulose 5-phosphate is converted to 3,4-dihydroxy-2-butanone 4-phosphate plus formate; associated with Rhea RHEA:18457 and EC 4.1.99.12 in RibBA homologs.

entities.name: GTP cyclohydrolase II reaction
observations: GTP is converted to a ribitylamino-pyrimidine precursor with formate and phosphate products; associated with Rhea RHEA:23704 and EC 3.5.4.25 in RibBA homologs.

entities.name: RibBA metal cofactors
observations: Reviewed RibBA homologs are annotated to bind two divalent metal ions, Mg2+ or Mn2+, and one Zn2+ per subunit; this is homology-based for the provided sequence.
